The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's premature declaration at step 29 that the request was satisfied. It listed Kang's Tae Kwon Do Academy (a martial arts club) and two Mount Pleasant, SC businesses, which are far outside the Point Pleasant, WV area, as verified nearby gyms. It also never checked the Yelp results it had seen, which named other local gyms such as Anytime Fitness, Planet Fitness, and Power Up Sports & Wellness. Root Sports & Fitness Center, one of the correct answers, was never found or verified.
